name: Scheduler Chaos Testing
description: Chaos test the scheduler: kill agents mid-task, corrupt messages, partition the network, exhaust resources.
purpose: Validate scheduler resiliency under adversarial conditions to ensure production-grade fault tolerance.
acceptanceCriteria: Agent-kill during task execution is handled: task is reassigned after lease expiry
Message corruption is detected and does not corrupt scheduler state
Network partition is handled: agents re-sync after reconnection
Resource exhaustion is handled gracefully with backpressure
Each chaos experiment has a clear hypothesis, procedure, and pass/fail criteria
Chaos experiments are automated and repeatable in CI
